The Epoch Super Mario Galaxy Action Pinball Game for Solo Play delivers the thrill of classic pinball blended with the cherished Super Mario Galaxy universe. Crafted for individual enjoyment, this captivating game prompts you to operate the paddle, skillfully launching balls to overcome adversaries before facing the ultimate boss. Its compact, vibrant design offers a delightful addition to any play area, fostering fine motor skills and rapid decision-making in young players.

Constructed from resilient materials and showcasing beloved characters, this pinball diversion provides countless hours of entertainment for kids aged 4 and up. The package contains multiple balls and enemy figures, guaranteeing abundant action-filled playtime. Perfect for Nintendo aficionados and pinball enthusiasts alike, this game fuses nostalgia with interactive fun in a secure, non-battery format.

Details

• Product Material: Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene ps TPE

• Manufacturer: EPOCH

Features

  • Contains primary device, 3 projectiles, 3 foe characters, and 2 Yarayama parts for engaging play
  • Does not require batteries, offering convenience and immediate readiness for play
  • Advised for children aged 4 years or older, ensuring secure and suitable amusement
  • Modest dimensions with a multi-hued aesthetic provides visual charm and straightforward storage
  • Official product from Nintendo and Universal City Studios LLC, guaranteeing accurate character portrayal

How to use

Set the central unit on a level plane and insert the spheres into the launching mechanism. Employ the flipper to strike the balls toward the opposing characters, with the goal of conquering the left and right adversaries prior to facing the boss. Successful play demands accurate timing and exactness to complete the stages. Always keep tiny components out of reach of children younger than 3 years to avoid potential choking dangers.

Care instructions

Wipe down the item with a gentle, moistened fabric to eliminate surface dust and grime. Steer clear of harsh chemicals or rough cleaning agents that could harm the finish. Keep the game in a dry spot, away from direct sunlight, to maintain its vibrant colors and structural integrity. Periodically inspect small components to confirm they remain undamaged and securely fastened.
